finding.claim: as_datetime keeps a non-UTC offset instead of converting it, so its docstring ("an aware UTC datetime") is false, and _date_text labels the local time with Z. generated.at 2026-10-03T09:00:00+02:00 prints as 2026-10-03T09:00:00Z, two hours off.

fixes.change: front_matter reads UTF-8 and raises BadFrontMatter naming the file when the YAML or encoding is bad; as_datetime converts an offset datetime to UTC.
